verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI's core interface is Python API/CLI, not natural language, but it offers an official MCP server (docs.crawl4ai.com/core/self-hosting) enabling AI assistants like Claude/Cursor to drive it via natural-language prompts, and community guides describe bridging it to n8n/MCP for agentic use. This makes AI-native operation possible but only through an add-on integration layer rather than a native NL command interface.
